canonical_name: Linux VRF device and l3mdev routing-domain model

first_operational.notes: Current kernel documentation preserves iproute2 4.7 and kernel 4.8 transition points; exact initial VRF merge should be tracked separately.

roles: associate an L3 master device with a routing table
provide routing-domain separation inside a network namespace
bind sockets/process traffic to a VRF domain
open_questions: Recover original VRF device merge commit and early netdev discussion.

supports: VRF device/table association, L3 scope, namespace composition and iproute2 support

related_artifacts.notes: VRF can be nested inside network namespaces; scopes differ.
l3mdev FIB rule directs lookups to VRF-associated tables.

notes: Do not describe a VRF as a lightweight namespace; it is primarily an L3 routing-domain mechanism.
